scope: High-level public-carrier architecture comparison for prototype V100/SXM2 power sanity check; no CAD reuse.

key_observation: No examined public carrier source publishes a requirement for six independently precision-regulated 6 A V100/SXM2 power loops; common/high-capacity 12 V entry and distribution is the observed pattern.
limits: OSHWHub page does not expose complete power schematic or ratings in accessible text.

Public precedent does not establish PiSXMe-specific contact, copper, transient, thermal, sequencing, or safety margins.
decision_boundary: Librarian evidence only; Product/Power Authority selects architecture and sets binding requirements.
